r1: M1-R1 working source at sample time

environment.rendering: Headless Chromium ANGLE SwiftShader software rendering

method.positioning: Real keyboard/mouse inputs only; initial spawn/camera from each project; matching A1 observation target reached by walking and mouse aim. No direct body/camera mutation. A1 walking tolerance is 0.20 metres; actual coordinates and rotations are retained in every sample.
method.nativeFrameMs: Native performance.now duration includes simulation plus scene/portal render submission, not GPU completion.
method.fps: Read-only native time.frameCount delta divided by elapsed wall time; no artificial time advancement.
method.precision: Short nonisolated cloud samples, frame cap 60; report per-run values and actual poses/render pixels, not a hardware target guarantee.

limitations: Software rendering on a shared cloud CPU; not representative of Windows hardware GPU performance.
Short stationary camera samples cover entry and one portal view, not full level worst-case profiling.
No local Windows TTS voice assets were available; this measures subtitles, companion, machinery cues and geometry, not actual voice decoding.
Browser automation is not human usability testing.

A1 actual poses are close rather than identical (X10.91–11.02, Z8.34–8.58 metres); baseline rendered 3 portal views and R1 rendered 4 at this camera. These samples compare the whole redesigned scene, not the isolated cost of the companion.
R1 has measurable overhead in these software-rendered samples; no claim of unchanged frame rate or Windows target performance is made.
